<module id="float_multi">
    <description>A 32-bit floating point multiplier for IEEE-754 standard single precision arithmetic.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset signal (active-high).</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the multiplication in IEEE 754 format.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="INIT">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="INPUT">State after extracting operands.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SPECIAL_CASES">State for handling special cases.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NORMALIZE">State for normalizing mantissas.</parameter>
        <parameter id="MULTIPLY">State for performing multiplication.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ROUND_ADJUST">State for rounding and adjusting the result.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT">Final output generation state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="counter" type="reg" width="3">Cycle counter for operation sequencing.</signal>
        <signal id="a_mantissa" type="reg" width="24">Mantissa of input number a.</signal>
        <signal id="b_mantissa" type="reg" width="24">Mantissa of input number b.</signal>
        <signal id="z_mantissa" type="reg" width="24">Mantissa of output number z.</signal>
        <signal id="a_exponent" type="reg" width="10">Exponent of input number a.</signal>
        <signal id="b_exponent" type="reg" width="10">Exponent of input number b.</signal>
        <signal id="z_exponent" type="reg" width="10">Exponent of output number z.</signal>
        <signal id="a_sign" type="reg">Sign bit of input number a.</signal>
        <signal id="b_sign" type="reg">Sign bit of input number b.</signal>
        <signal id="z_sign" type="reg">Sign bit of output number z.</signal>
        <signal id="product" type="reg" width="50">Intermediate product of mantissas.</signal>
        <signal id="guard_bit" type="reg">Guard bit for rounding.</signal>
        <signal id="round_bit" type="reg">Round bit for rounding.</signal>
        <signal id="sticky" type="reg">Sticky bit for rounding.</signal>
        
        // State machine for controlling the operation flow
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge rst)>
            if (rst) begin
                counter <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                case(counter)
                    3'd0: counter <= 3'd1; // Move to INPUT state
                    3'd1: counter <= 3'd2; // Move to SPECIAL_CASES state
                    3'd2: counter <= 3'd3; // Move to NORMALIZE state
                    3'd3: counter <= 3'd4; // Move to MULTIPLY state
                    3'd4: counter <= 3'd5; // Move to ROUND_ADJUST state
                    3'd5: counter <= 3'd6; // Move to OUTPUT state
                    default: counter <= 3'd0; // Default to INIT state
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Extracting mantissas, exponents, and sign bits from input numbers
        <always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (counter == 3'd0) begin
                a_mantissa <= {1'b1, a[22:0]};
                b_mantissa <= {1'b1, b[22:0]};
                a_exponent <= a[30:23];
                b_exponent <= b[30:23];
                a_sign <= a[31];
                b_sign <= b[31];
            end
        end
        
        // Handling special cases such as NaN and Infinity
        <always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (counter == 3'd1) begin
                if ((a_exponent == 8'hFF && a_mantissa != 0) || (b_exponent == 8'hFF && b_mantissa != 0)) begin
                    z <= {1'b1, 8'hFF, 23'h0}; // Set output to NaN
                end else if (a_exponent == 8'hFF) begin
                    z <= {a_sign ^ b_sign, 8'hFF, 23'h0}; // Output Infinity
                end else if (b_exponent == 8'hFF) begin
                    z <= {a_sign ^ b_sign, 8'hFF, 23'h0}; // Output Infinity
                end else begin
                    z <= 32'h0; // Normal case
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Normalizing mantissas if necessary
        <always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (counter == 3'd2) begin
                if (a_exponent == 0) begin
                    a_mantissa <= {1'b0, a_mantissa[23:1]};
                    a_exponent <= a_exponent + 1;
                end
                if (b_exponent == 0) begin
                    b_mantissa <= {1'b0, b_mantissa[23:1]};
                    b_exponent <= b_exponent + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Multiplying mantissas and adjusting the exponent
        <always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (counter == 3'd3) begin
                product <= a_mantissa * b_mantissa;
                z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent - 127;
                z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
            end
        end
        
        // Rounding and adjusting the result
        <always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (counter == 3'd4) begin
                guard_bit <= product[24]; // Guard bit
                round_bit <= product[23]; // Round bit
                sticky <= |product[22:0]; // Sticky bit
                if (guard_bit & (round_bit | sticky | z_mantissa[0])) begin
                    z_mantissa <= z_mantissa + 1;
                    if (z_mantissa == 24'hFFFFFF) begin
                        z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Generating the final output
        <always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (counter == 3'd5) begin
                if (z_exponent >= 255) begin
                    z <= {z_sign, 8'hFF, 23'h0}; // Overflow to Infinity
                end else if (z_exponent <= 0) begin
                    z <= {z_sign, 8'h00, 23'h0}; // Underflow to Zero
                end else begin
                    z <= {z_sign, z_exponent[7:0], z_mantissa[22:0]};
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
</module>
